maria (infra-lead): Heads-up: on Tue 2026-04-01 we'll cut CI/CD over to OIDC service accounts for all Redwood-managed runners. This removes long-lived GitHub PATs used by our runner pools. Please rotate any repo-level PATs and check secrets by EOD Fri. https://redwood-infra/internal/sso-cutover :rocket:

antoine (devex): Do we have a quick checklist for repos that still use PATs? Can devs opt out of the cutover?

maria (infra-lead): Checklist inlined below. Opt-out only for critical compliance cases — file a request in #eng-platform and include justification. We'll keep a short-lived legacy window but no permanent PATs.

maria (infra-lead): ```
Cutover checklist (TL;DR):
1) run `scripts/check-secrets.sh` in your repo -> report path
2) replace PATs with OIDC-runner role or use org-level GH App
3) test builds in the staging runner pool (tag: oidc-ready)
4) notify infra after tests, we'll flip routing to OIDC
5) confirm telemetry + logs show no auth failures
6) rotate any remaining service account keys via KMS
```

sam (platform-eng): I found 3 repos still using plaintext PATs in secrets-manager. I'll DM the owners and help migrate. Any recommended library snippets for exchanging tokens?

maria (infra-lead): Thanks Sam. Use the internal helper: `oidc-helper` (repo: redwood/oidc-helper). Example in the doc for `actions/setup-oidc` usage.

jen (security): Strong 👍 on the audit. A couple of non-negotiables: enable org SCIM provisioning for all new service principals, and set alerting for token-usage anomalies during and for 7 days after cutover. I'll add a runbook for incident detection.

ops-bot: scheduled: cutover-preflight-check at 2026-03-31T23:00:00Z. Notify #eng-oncall if any preflight fails.

antoine (devex): For folks running self-hosted runners in customer infra (not managed by Redwood), is there guidance?

maria (infra-lead): For customer/self-hosted runners, they must rotate to OIDC too — but we cannot enforce. We'll publish a migration playbook and tag repos that may require assistance. We'll also provide a temporary proxy for registries that only accept PATs until end of April.

sam (platform-eng): Question: any impact on webhook integrations that use app tokens?

maria (infra-lead): Webhooks that rely on app-level tokens are unaffected. This is focused on runner auth to GitHub. If you have integrations tied to runner credentials, open a ticket.

jen (security): Also: all service accounts must be added to our audit logs (CloudTrail-equivalent + internal SIEM). I'll coordinate with Observability to ensure log retention is set to 90 days for these events.

antoine (devex): Is there a fallback plan in case cutover breaks nightly releases?

maria (infra-lead): Yes — rollback plan: revert runner routing (infra config), revert org runner labels to legacy pool, and re-enable emergency PAT routing for 2 hours while we triage. We'll run the rollback only after notifying #release-war-room.

deploy-bot: reminder: planned cutover window 2026-04-01 02:00-03:30 UTC. Automated DNS routing + runner config flip.

sam (platform-eng): I'll be online for the window and will monitor builds. Ping me if you need hotfixes.

jen (security): I'll watch alerts and be on-call during the window. Ping me @here if anything spikes. :warning:

maria (infra-lead): Appreciate it everyone. If you have repos that absolutely cannot migrate by Friday, add them to the spreadsheet (link in the doc) and include owner, reason, and ETA. We'll triage on Monday. :thumbsup:

antoine (devex): Great — I'll post a short how-to in #devex with the most common fixes (env vs repo secret swaps).

sam (platform-eng): Heads-up: I spotted one CI job that uses a `deploy-service` script with embedded creds. I'll send a patch.

maria (infra-lead): Perfect. Final ask: if you see any service accounts not labeled `redwood-oidc-*`, please flag them. We'll run a nightly audit before the flip.

ops-bot: audit-runner-check completed: 12 failing repos found. See https://redwood-infra/reports/oidc-audit-2026-03-28

maria (infra-lead): OK, team — we'll follow up with a small preflight meeting tomorrow at 15:00 UTC. Invite sent.
